notes.title: The Chef's Shift is out now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're really excited to announce that The Chef's Shift is out now! For the launch, the game will be [b]available for 10% off for the first week[/b]!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390230/The_Chefs_Shift/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

[h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]A mix of the typing and cooking genre[/b], where you'll have to up your WPM to cook and serve the customers.
[*] [b]6 restaurants from all over the world[/b], each with their own cuisines, culture, and challenges.
[*] [b]A fun storyline[/b] with a colorful cast of characters and choices to make, offering 6–9 hours of playtime.
[*] [b]Endless mode[/b], where you can customize everything from customer types to dishes, rat spawns and patience timers. Pick whichever options you'd like and practice or challenge yourself as the customers keep coming!
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update for Cooking Fest and TLGA Awards!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2919650/view/4268931197580032263]Continuing from the Beta Branch[/url], we received many feedback, and we intend to solve them for upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/cooking]Steam Cooking Festival[/url].
And also on different occasion, Cookard is nominated in The Lazy Game Awards, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2919650/view/4518891758024655186]we have full write up about that here[/url].

Now we have merged the Beta Branch to the Main Branch, applying all the modification. We have also received many feedback on our Beta Branch, and we decide to fix it. Here are several feedback on the beta branch:
[list]
[*] The ant mechanic is annoying, and we have gotten rid of it
[*] The UI is too big, and we have reduced it
[*] You guys want to generate Egg and Honey without buying it, I've already included in this iteration
[/list]

And also we add some decoration for Cooking Fest :D.

[h1]About The Beta Branch[/h1]
If you guys haven't know about the Beta Branch, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2919650/view/4268931197580032263]you could check this post to see what is it about[/url].
But in general we add this thing:
[list]
[*] Rebalance Quest and Progression: now we have Packs that need certain amount of Coin to open or certain amount of Clicks. And also the progression is a little bit longer, to space out the feature
[*] Chest Card: now we have Chest mechanic, where you could store stuff
[*] More Worker Utility: now worker could do several thing, not only running on the wheel, for example stopping customer from coming
[*] Refined Magnet: now a single magnet could pull many card type at once. And you could set it to pull certain amount or unlimited amount. Before this iteration, it could only pull unlimited amount. This is useful for automating the Oven and Stove.
[*] Auto Clicker: There's a card that could spawn cursor to click another card
[*] Recipe Balancing: There's so much surplus of egg before the beta branch, we add new Recipe to balance out the ingredients usage, such as Meringue and Pavlova.
[*] New Recipe and Ingredients: We have Blender and have Juice Recipes.
[*] Some Quality of Life: we make the UI hideable, and more info about the card
[*] The Enemy: in the beta branch, we have some enemy that will steal your card. But later it's not really well received, so we decide to take it out again.
[/list]

[h1]About The New Version (v1.1.2)[/h1]
Basically it's like beta branch but we take out the Ant Invasion.
And also we add new way to generate Egg and Honey.

For the Egg:
[list]
[*] Put Egg in Incubator, it will hatch into Chicken
[*] The Chicken can not be picked up, and will move by itself.
[*] If you click the Chicken multiple times, it will spawn 3 Eggs then disappears.
[/list]

For the Honey:
[list]
[*] Put Worker in Garden, and supply it with Water, it will spawn Flower around it.
[*] Flower can not be picked up, and doesn't move. But it will destroyed if we click on it.
[*] The Hive Card will spawn Bee, and Bee will search for the nearest Flower, pluck it and put it in the Hive
[*] Then it the Hive will process it into Honey.
[/list]

[h1]About The Lazy Game Awards[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2919650/view/4518891758024655186]We are glad that we are nominated for Best Indonesian Game Direction and also Indonesia Game of The Year.[/url]
The Lazy Game Awards is an annual B2C gamedev event in Indonesia, organized by The Lazy Monday Media, and it's there to appreciate the gamedeveloper from Indonesia.
It would mean so much if you could help us vote Cookard. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2919650/view/4518891758024655186]We've written the full guide how to do it here[/url].

[h1]About The Chef's Shift[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390230/The_Chefs_Shift/
We are sorry for the slow update for the Cookard, because currently we are working on The Chef's Shift. It's our other game that recently (4 months ago) received funding from the publisher, and we are eager to finish it.
And also The Chef's Shift will join The Cooking Festival too! I hope you guys will try it and help wishlisting it!

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We have noticed that Cookard has many players, we haven't expected this for an experimental game project. And we think it's potential to be developed more. So we are considering to develop more of this game after we finished our current game The Chef's Shift. There's a possibility that we made a premium sequel of Cookard, with more feature and longer gameplay time.
I hope you follow our journey until the end! Cheers!

notes.title: Beta v1.1.1
notes.content:
Some players reported there's a crash in Beta when they hover cards when some machine finishes making food.
It's fixed now, I hope.

The crash only happens when in release version, in Godot editor or debug version it's not happened.
The suspect is if we invoke Callable from an Object that has been recently freed, it will crash the game, and it's only happen in release version. So basically I add guard "if callable.is_valid():" before calling it.
It seems fixed the crash.

notes.title: Chest, More Worker's Job, More Recipe, and Ants! - Beta Branch v1.1.0 is Up!
notes.content:
Hey, the promised Beta Branch is here. It's version 1.1.0 and you could try it now by changing the branch into beta branch. For now, it only works on Windows.

To change to beta branch, just right click Cookard on your library, then go to Properties
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/f4cf37a5e5cb934f8f8e053d9359fb6211ba12e7.png[/img]

Then go to Betas section, and in Beta Participation, change None to beta.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/8cd127ef3022dc7cd5896e4bfae7d52af5c951be.png[/img]

If you want to change back to main branch, just do the same but change it to None.

Several warning though, the save file won't be compatible between beta branch and the main branch, so you need to reset your save file before starting the other branch.
If you would like, you could backup your save file, for each OS, here is the path:

[code]
Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Cookard\save_data.sav
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Cookard/save_data.sav
Linux: ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Cookard/save_data.sav
[/code]

Now here is some changes from the main branch:

[h1]Rebalanced Quest and Progression[/h1]
Some players complained that when it unlocks recipe, it gives so many recipes all at once, and overwhelmed by it.
We have balanced it so that the recipes are more spread out, and it means you need complete more popularity to unlock it.
The game will be longer around 30%, because in the main branch, the game will finish when you serve around 100 customers, and in the beta branch you need to serve around 130 customers.

Some recipes, should be bought first with coin, and some need certain amount of click to unlock it.
It will be more a little bit challenging, and now the coin has some other usage than buying packs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/8e06d2a5b77b0fed9026a76d9257c22832e76cd4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/93930d7787b439e8e1a747d89240fed3d4977400.gif[/img]

[h1]Chest Card[/h1]
This is pretty much number one request from players. So now you could unlock Chest in later stage. After it stores the first card, it will store another card with the same type.
Chest Card need to be on the first card on the stack to store card. You could click the card to retrieve its content or use magnet to draw the card from the inside.
We hope, with this addition, your kitchen is more manageable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/f6c8af2364e3cbccfb29ae59eb73b5259f716d16.gif[/img]

[h1]Worker could stop Customer from Coming![/h1]
Another thing that players requested is the ability to stop Customer from coming. They need something like pause, but need all the machine working.
Now you could put your Worker on the Queue Card, and it will act as Bouncer. It will stop the future Customer from coming. But beware that the Worker still needs to eat, if not they will leave and decrease your popularity!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/b8f46caa0380ae3b21c25aae6fda7a535a258799.gif[/img]

[h1]Now you could automate Food with Magnet![/h1]
In the main branch, the Magnet behaviour is taking as much as ingredient that is on its range.
So if you only need [b]one[/b] Dough and [b]one[/b] Honey to make Bagel, the Magnet will take as much as possible Dough and Honey, and your Oven won't work.
Now you could setup your Magnet to only take [b]one[/b] Dough and [b]one[/b] Honey only and stop taking when it already has that much.
Now the Magnet could take multiple stuff all at once, just put the required ingredient in the Inductor.
But if you want the Magnet behave like it's used to, which is taking as much as possible, then you could stack Unlimited Card with Inductor Card, then it will make the Magnet taking as much as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/7d756ba35ce7ceb03c32b45d0dfe9966e9442321.gif[/img]

[h1]Automate Opening Pack and Delivering Food to Customers[/h1]
To automate all the kitchen, you need a way to open the pack automatically, now the pack need to be opened manually. That's why there will be a new Click Farm Card. You could put Worker there to work as Clicker, and it will spawn Cursor Click and it will click Card that need to be clicked, like opening pack, or other stuff.
Actually you could use multiple of Click Farm with Water Pump to generate Water faster. But a little bit warning, it won't be cost effective than the Tap. Because it's less efficient, means the Worker will hungry faster for the same amount of Water generated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/5bbdcb441e217387562f1961379b475aeaf888f2.gif[/img]

The last piece of puzzle of full automation is delivering food for the Customer. There will be Waiter Station, where you could put Worker there to be Waiter. And it will deliver Card on its stack to whoever Customer or Worker that need that food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/77b0d7580ed8f14f76d3eb02036c087e985622b0.gif[/img]

[h1]More Egg Based Recipe![/h1]
Many players complained that they have too much Egg. Now we balanced it out with new recipe. There will be Meringue, where you need to Whisk the Egg into Foam, and bake it into Oven. And also Pavlova, where you combine Meringue, Strawberry, Blueberry, and Orange on Stove.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/fbe1399b8461ce0c9850d38b48d192569e21d22a.gif[/img]

And also, for the late game challenge, we pop up another tool which is Blender, where you could make Strawberry Juice, Blueberry Juice, and Orange Juice where each recipe need two corresponding Fruits. I hope it will be challenging. I hope you don't scream when you have tons of leftovers Blueberry and Orange, but the Customer asks for Strawberry Juice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/e38188e1c6dcaf97085ff87220538ba3e6a73558.gif[/img]

[h1]Ant will steal your Food![/h1]
As designer, I love to add challenge into the game. And for this branch we introduce some enemy. It's not hard, but it's a little bit annoying. In the later stage, the game will start to spawn some Ant Nest, and this Ant Nest will constantly spawning Ant. This Ant will try to steal your food, but don't worry, it's pretty easy to exterminate it, just click the Ant, and poof it's gone.
You might wonder if there's any way to automate clicking those ants... wait you have Click Farm right? :3

You could try to exterminate the Ant Nest itself by placing Worker there as Exterminator, it will consume the energy of the Worker and certainly they will ask food more regularly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/fec7c440741a8d3494a5ec381e86bd6722d69a50.gif[/img]

[h1]Some UI/UX fix and Quality of Life[/h1]
We add pattern to the background, in hope that it's more intuitive that you could place the card outside the main board, because some players fail to notice this.
And also there's several request to be able to hide the info panel and keyboard help on the bottom, because it gets in the way, and we have added it :D.
Another thing is, now you could hover to any progress bar to see how much the progress is. And also there's more information on the card now, so you could now the status of the card.

And lastly, for the recipe that only has one way to produce, we just put the recipe when you click the corresponding card, it's just easier that way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983116/5240ba4a1bcea343a3ac93ddcabc902aecd80d7f.gif[/img]

[h1]And that's it![/h1]
Thank you for supporting and playing this game! We really need your feedback about this change. We could not update for more feature or stuff, but we will still try to update to bug fix, improve the QoL, and rebalance the game. It's because our team will shift our focus to our other game, The Chef's Shift, we intent to finish it because we already got ourselves a publisher for that game :D.
Please support The Chef's Shift by wishlisting it! Thanks :D.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390230/The_Chefs_Shift/?utm_source=post_cookard_v1.1.0

notes.title: Mac Update to v1.0.9
notes.content:
Finally we have updated Mac to v1.0.9. We use Godot to create this game and it has a bug that if we use GPU Particle on Compability Renderer Mode, it will crash on the newer version of Mac, the one that use M1 Chip.

Shout out to [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/AbortressPSX]Abortress[/url] who helps me identify the issue!

So yeah enjoy! Next we will update the beta branch to include latest cutting edge, not bug free feature!

notes.title: Mac Rollback to v1.0.6
notes.content: It seems the Mac version v1.0.9 has a bug. Until we fix it, we roll it back to v1.0.6, because the bug causes crash and make the game unplayable.

notes.title: Update v1.0.9 - Localization, Fixing QoL / UX, and Beta Branch
notes.content:
Hello all, thank you once again for trying our game! We are really excited that you are excited with this free game!
Hearing your feedback we have several stuff that we hear over and over:
[list]
[*] You need the game translated into your language, there's so many Chinese player asks for this!
[*] You didn't like that the music is really loud
[*] You didn't like the hover sound, it's pretty annoying
[*] You are irritated with big pause icon when paused
[*] You want Coin Chest to store overflow Coin, and to make it more tidy
[*] You want the ability to stop the Customer from coming over and over, because you are still trying to complete the quest
[*] You want Steam Achievement!
[*] You feel frustrated in the beginning, not sure what to do... especially with Magnet Card!
[*] You want step by step tutorial
[*] You want Honey Generation Mechanic with Bee or such
[*] You want more end game content, more recipes, tools, some way to spend excess coins and extend the gameplay time in general
[/list]

So for this update, we have tackled the localization. Currently we have 5 Languages that are ready in this update:
[list]
[*] English (the default)
[*] Indonesian - translated by dev team, thanks Hanassiy for the effort!
[*] German - translated by [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-edgina-b579b0131/]aetherin[/url]
[*] Simplified Chinese - translated by [url=https://www.know-team.com/]°Know Team[/url]:西尔诺特, vmpt, LeanderLin
[*] Russian - translated by [url=https://thebullfinchteam.tilda.ws/]The Bullfinch Team[/url]
[/list]

Many thanks for the translator that works on the localization pro bono. We will not have this localization without you! :')

So we have adjusted some other aspect too:
[list]
[*] In addition to panning camera with WASD, you could now pan it with Middle Click
[*] bug fix the smoke sound that still played when the sfx volume set to 0%
[*] rebalance the efficiency of the Oven MK2 and Stove MK2 from 2 to 1.5
[*] changing font to support Chinese and Russian script
[*] add language settings, and move the credits to its own screen
[*] remove that annoying hover sound
[*] reduce the overall volume by 25%
[*] change the big pause icon into small blink text on the middle of the screen
[*] change the price of Fruit Bagel from 6 to 5
[/list]

I hope with this change, it gives much more enjoyable experience to players.

And also, we want to make a Beta Branch, where everyone could try the Beta Branch, but with caution, because in Beta Branch, it won't be stable. It's the branch where we want to experiment, and add new feature. Your save file will probably won't work and you need to start from the beginning each update in Beta Branch. After we have made sure that the Beta Branch stable and fun, then we move it to the Main Branch.
So if you are daring player and want to experience the latest feature that we work on, we invite you to join our Beta Branch!

For the next update, we might address this issue first:
[list]
[*] Adding Coin Chest or Resource Chest
[*] Adding a Mechanic to Pause the Customer from coming
[/list]

Then after that we try to tackle Steam Achievement.

Then after that, we will add Step by Step Tutorial

And lastly some major content update, new card, new recipe, new mechanic, and new late game goal.

I hope you always support this game until the end and spread the word about this game!

Cheers!
Ali Jaya Meilio
Panitia GameDev

P.S
Forget to mention, that we want to give a shout out to massobeats, because we use their free non-copyrighted Lo-Fi Music for this game. It's titled Honey Jam, and could be accessed [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HGMQbVfYVmI&utm_source=cookard]here[/url].
A little bit note if you want to post the your playthrough on Youtube, it seems if you blast this music when playing it could get copyright claimed despite it's a free non-copyrighted music. You could avoid that by crediting massobeats on the description of the uploaded video by writing "Music by: massobeats - honey jam".
Or if you prefer, you could turn off the BGM and blast any other BGM from your own playlist :D.

notes.title: Small Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello all, we have received many complaint that the audio is too loud...
We have checked the code, and we found that we have made the mistake that the audio is 4x louder than intended, we are really sorry about that :')

So here is some patch notes on this update:
[list]
[*] Reduce the overall volume of BGM and SFX
[*] Disable panning with mouse, because some of the players annoyed by it, so you could only move the camera using WASD
[*] Now you could drop the card without aiming the last card on the stack, if you drop in the middle, it will automatically drop at the last card on the stack
[*] Fixing the Pause, Speed Up shortcut, before sometimes you could not use shortcut, it's because the focus is locked into another UI
[*] Putting more description on the quest, so it could guide the player more.
[*] Change the display of the recipe, so it's more user friendly
[*] Slow down the customer spawn rate, now the customer will spawn more slowly if there's many customer on the queue
[/list]

Next up we want to do some localization in Simplified Chinese, and also make tutorial for the game so the player won't be confused in the early game.

Thank you all for supporting this game :D.

Cheers,
Ali

notes.title: Cookard Demo is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

The Demo of Cookard is now available on Steam!
The game will be free at launch, this demo is just an appetizer for the full release :D.

Cookard is a cooking card game. You click, drag, and combine card to make baguette, wash dish, serve the customer, or buy the supplies! Later in the game, you will do the automation, [strike]slave[/strike] hire the customer to be your worker generating electricity and using magnet to move stuff!

The full release will be on 10 May 2024. Don't forget to wishlist it, it will help the Steam algorithm to push this game up :D.
